name: GRAD 5930
title: Full-Time Directed Studies (Master's Level)
description: This course denotes that the student is participating in a full-time internship, field work experience, or other course of off-campus study required as part of the student's Master's program. No other courses may be taken concurrently. May be repeated for a total of 12 credits.
requirement_description: To be used by master's students only, not Ph.D. students.
